name: Longhorn Wrecker
_tow_boom_note: The Hook is equipment, not a superpower: only a profile with tow_boom true can hook anything. Jack a sedan and you are just a guy in a sedan.
_identity: THE BASELINE IS SACRED. The smoke test drives this rig, so every motion field below (mass, engine, brakes, steer, suspension, grip, drag, com, geometry) is FROZEN and has been since M1 -- SMOKE PASS pos=(193.000000, 1.097957, 517.465332) moved=40.5m speed=16.7m/s is a byte-for-byte contract. Wrecker changes are visual-only fields ONLY (color, rim_color, rim_style, plate_text, door_text, body_style). Its character, for the record and not for editing: the heaviest springs and damping in the fleet (68000 / 7200, 0.56 of critical), the grippiest tires (1.42), the lowest CoM (-0.45) and the tightest steer falloff (0.022) -- a working truck that hooks up, holds a line, and does not care what you meant. Measured M16: 5.67 s to 20 m/s, 28.2 m from 30 to 0, 60.3 deg/s at full lock -- mid-pack on pace, near the top on brakes and grip.
